command:start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }'); base=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "cannot tell where this task branch started: no 'gnomish: task started' commit and no origin/main"; exit 1; }; oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: scripts/zoneRules/checkAgainstZdump.ts:49-51 defines its own `SECONDS_PER_MINUTE = 60`, `SECONDS_PER_HOUR = 3600`, `SECONDS_PER_DAY = 86400`. Lines 9-15 of the same file already import from `../../src/lib/zoneRules/core/index.ts`, which exports all three (core/index.ts:19-21). This breaks code-style.md: "Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant" and antipatterns.md: "Second owner of a concept — a new ... constant that computes what a ... owner already computes". Import them from core instead.

scripts/zoneRules/releaseZonePeriods.ts:22 defines `const MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND = 1000;`. The import on lines 8-16 of the same file comes from `core/index.ts`, which exports `MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND` (core/index.ts:17). Add it to that import and delete the local copy.

src/lib/zoneRules/currentInstant.ts:16-25 defines `HOURS_PER_DAY = 24` and `MILLISECONDS_PER_MINUTE = SECONDS_PER_MINUTE * MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND`. `MILLISECONDS_PER_MINUTE` already has an owner: `src/constants/clock.ts:2` (`export const MILLISECONDS_PER_MINUTE = 60_000`), re-exported from `@/constants`, which this file already imports on line 8. Import the existing constant. Give `HOURS_PER_DAY` and the derived hour and day millisecond constants one shared home (`@/constants` or core) instead of a private copy. The grid_view e2e steps define their own `HOURS_PER_DAY = 24` too.

src/lib/zoneRules/core/zoneRulesConstants.ts:40 and :46 hold two constants for the same fact: `DAYS_PER_YEAR_WITHOUT_LEAP_DAY = 365` (used by futureRule.ts:88-89) and `DAYS_PER_COMMON_YEAR = 365` (used by epochDays.ts:46). Keep one and use it in both places.

Small calendar and arithmetic values are repeated across zone rules files instead of having one constant: `JANUARY = 1` in core/futureRuleOffset.ts:39 and scripts/zoneRules/releaseZonePeriods.ts:23; the first day as `FIRST_DAY` (futureRuleOffset.ts:40), `FIRST_DAY_OF_YEAR` (futureRule.ts:55) and `FIRST_DAY_OF_MONTH` (releaseZonePeriods.ts:24). The binary-search midpoint is a bare `/ 2` in core/localTimeType.ts:35 and releaseZonePeriods.ts:66, while checkAgainstZdump.ts:52 names the same divisor `MIDPOINT_DIVISOR = 2`. Per code-style.md ("Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant"), move these into core's zoneRulesConstants.ts and import them.

findings.message: packages/client/scripts/zoneRules/readTzif.ts:102 uses a bare number literal: `view.getUint32(timeOffset + 4)` (offset of the low 32-bit half of a 64-bit transition time). .claude/rules/code-style.md: "Numbers (except 0, 1, -1 in loops/indices)" are hardcoded values; "Are there any numbers other than 0/1/-1? → Extract into a constant". Use a named constant (e.g. TRANSITION_TIME_LOW_HALF_OFFSET).

packages/client/scripts/zoneRules/readTzif.ts:54-57 reads the TZif header counts with bare field positions `readCount(2)`, `readCount(3)`, `readCount(4)`, `readCount(5)` (tzh_leapcnt, tzh_timecnt, tzh_typecnt, tzh_charcnt). Same rule from .claude/rules/code-style.md; name the header field positions (e.g. a const object of count field indices), as the file already does for TYPE_DAYLIGHT_FLAG_OFFSET / TYPE_DESIGNATION_INDEX_OFFSET.

packages/client/src/lib/zoneRules/zoneNameParts.ts:27 uses `String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")` with a bare `2` for the minutes width in `GMT±H:MM`. .claude/rules/code-style.md: "Numbers (except 0, 1, -1 in loops/indices)" must be extracted into a constant; the change already does this in scripts/zoneRules/checkAgainstZdump.ts (`ISO_PAD_LENGTH = 2`). Name the width (e.g. OFFSET_MINUTES_DIGITS).

since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi
